source_findings: The upper-slope West Greenland Current core is associated with LS4 and LS5 in the four-year mean discussion and along-stream section.
The coastal current is strongest at LS1 and LS2 but merges with the slope flow in the mean; instantaneous separation is not guaranteed.
The paper explicitly states that the array did not extend sufficiently far onto the shelf to bracket the coastal current.
Figure 4 contains interpolated mean sections. Its colored spans do not supply independently observed monthly velocity edges.
osw_method_implications: A prospective upper-slope core diagnostic may require its selected peak to occur at LS4 or LS5 and retain ambiguity/censoring when that condition fails.
Such a diagnostic must define its own layer, filtering, paired threshold brackets and regional metric before execution.
Do not derive a full coastal-current width from this eight-mooring archive or infer its missing onshore edge from the coastline.
Do not use the four-year mean picture as evidence for full seasonal geometry or a month-specific width.
